comparison.objective: Secure an anchor line's bitter end and lower the anchor onto a seabed patch without losing either; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Line fastening, tether management, and controlled lowering versus rigid precision impact tooling and millimetre-scale debris collection.
comparison.success_condition: Anchor on the patch with line and anchor retained, then release everything, versus four safe fractures with all tangs in a tray and hardware intact. Knot and placement tolerances are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Tethered load deployment is not a duplicate of manufactured-notch fracture.
